name: Noctra
tagline: Enterprise booking for tattoo studios that outgrew the sticky-note calendar.
positioning: Noctra runs scheduling, deposits, consent, and aftercare across multi-location tattoo studios so your artists tattoo instead of chasing Instagram DMs.

hero.h1: The booking stack for tattoo studios that operate like a business.
hero.sub: Noctra handles scheduling, deposits, consent forms, and aftercare across every chair and every location — so your front desk stops running on screenshots and vibes.

features.title: Chairs, not chaos
features.description: Live availability across artists and locations, with buffers for stencils, breaks, and the client who is always fifteen minutes late.

features.title: Deposits that stick
features.description: Automated deposits, no-show fees, and rebooking rules enforced at checkout. Ghosting an appointment now costs the client, not you.

features.title: Consent, signed and stored
features.description: Digital consent, medical intake, and ID capture per session — versioned, timestamped, and exportable when your legal team asks.

features.title: Aftercare on autopilot
features.description: Healing instructions, touch-up reminders, and review prompts sent automatically. Fewer 'is this normal?' texts at 2am.

features.title: Artist payouts, sorted
features.description: Commission splits, booth rent, and product usage tracked per artist. Payday math stops living in a spreadsheet named final_v3.

features.title: Numbers you can act on
features.description: Utilization, rebooking rate, and revenue per chair across the whole group, benchmarked location by location.

testimonials.quote: We run eleven studios. Before Noctra, reconciling deposits and artist splits took a full week each month. Now it takes an afternoon and nobody rage-quits.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: The consent and intake trail is the part our insurers actually care about. Every session is documented the same way, whether it's Berlin or Brooklyn.
testimonials.name: Marcus Holt

testimonials.quote: No-shows dropped almost a third once deposits were enforced at booking. The artists stopped hating the booking software, which honestly felt impossible.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For single-location studios ready to retire the paper diary.
For multi-location operators who need one source of truth.
For franchises and studio networks with real compliance stakes.

homepage.footerBlurb: Noctra is the operating system for serious tattoo studios. Book chairs, collect deposits, prove consent, keep artists paid.
